newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-All Blacks burgled in South Africa.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-All Blacks burgled in South Africa.

text.p: PRETORIA, July 16 - The All Black rugby team's hotel was burgled here yesterday while they were out training at a police college, NZPA reported on Thursday (NZT).

At least four or five players, including Andrew Mehrtens, and members of the management team, including Dr John Mayhew and David Abercrombie, discovered last night they were missing hundreds of rands.
All Black team manager Mike Banks said members had lost about NZ$2000, taken from their wallets and luggage in their rooms.
The hotel's management believe that a man posing as a television technician was responsible for the burglaries.

Though there was a security guard on the level where the team are accommodated at the Holiday Inn Crown Plaza on the edge of the city, the man had managed to trick his way into the rooms, the management said.
Banks said one of the team's assistant coaches Gordon Hunter, a Dunedin police detective, was helping with the investigation.
The All Blacks are staying in Pretoria to prepare for Sunday's (NZT) test against the Springboks at Johannesburg's Ellis Park.
